question: The scope-misreading results used one synthetic portfolio (seed 7). Do the two findings hold for other seeds: (a) on the original network both readings give the same dispatches; (b) a misread scope changes dispatches only when MY_road space is far below mean Malaysia demand?
seed_note: The seed draws SKU mass, value and mean demand as well as weekly orders, so each seed is a different synthetic portfolio. Seed 7 is the one already reported and is not repeated here.
decided_before_running: Fixed after the seed-7 results and before solving any other seed. No expectation about the threshold is assumed; whatever it is, it is reported per seed, including zero-regret and infeasible cases.
